unit.heading: Declaration of Inmate Filing
unit.reason: Institutional-mail declaration supplies filing-timeliness mechanism under Bankruptcy Rules 8002(c)(1) and 8011(a)(2)(C) for a party in an otherwise selected bankruptcy or appellate dispute. Incarceration alone does not make the procedure a separate criminal or habeas subject.

publisher_form_type: Director’s Bankruptcy Form, issued under Bankruptcy Rule 9009; local rules or general orders may require use.
